characters.name: Fisker
characters.description: A middle-aged man with a rugged appearance and weather-beaten skin. He is of average height and has a lean build, typical of someone who works hard physically. His hair is dark and unkempt, and he sports a slight stubble. He is dressed in simple, worn-out fishing attire, consisting of a beige tunic and dark trousers. His demeanor is one of resilience and determination, yet his eyes show a hint of worry and desperation due to his fruitless fishing efforts.

characters.name: Hodet fra vannet
characters.description: A mystical and ethereal presence, the head emerging from the water is otherworldly in appearance. It has a glowing, translucent quality and exudes an aura of mystery. The facial features are gentle yet enigmatic, with shimmering eyes that suggest depths of knowledge and power. This being communicates with a calm yet commanding presence.

characters.name: Gutt
characters.description: A young boy, in his early teens, with a bright and curious expression. He has sandy blond hair, short and untidy, and his eyes are wide with wonder and determination. He is of slender build and wears simple clothing typical of a young village boy, including a beige tunic and dark pants. A sense of adventure and courage emanates from him as he faces the challenges ahead.

characters.name: Gammel mann med hvidt skjegg
characters.description: An elderly man with a long, flowing white beard and a wise, weathered face. His eyes are sharp and piercing, filled with the wisdom of ages. He wears a simple robe, made of earthy tones, which adds to his sage-like appearance. His presence is calm and authoritative, someone who has seen much and knows many secrets.

characters.name: Tre Kongsdøtre
characters.description: Three princesses, each with a distinct regal bearing, yet only their heads visible above the ground. They have delicate, ethereal features and long flowing hair, each corresponding to their age - golden for the eldest, auburn for the middle, and raven black for the youngest. Their eyes carry a mixture of hope and desperation, pleading silently for rescue.

characters.name: Troll
characters.description: A formidable creature with three heads, each grotesque and fearsome. Its skin is a dark, murky green, mottled and thick, exuding a sense of ancient malevolence. The creature wields whips made of thorned vines, each movement purposeful and malicious. It embodies brutality and power, standing as a monstrous obstacle to overcome.

characters.name: Yngste Prinsesse
characters.description: The youngest of the three princesses, she is a vision of beauty and grace, with raven black hair cascading in waves around her shoulders. Her eyes are a deep blue, speaking of both strength and vulnerability. She is dressed in a gown of pale blue that shimmers in the light, highlighting her royal lineage. Her demeanor is both regal and gentle, determined to ensure her and her sisters' freedom.

characters.name: Unge konge
characters.description: The young king, now matured with noble bearing, stands confidently adorned in opulent garments befitting his newfound status. His hair is neatly styled, and his face is composed, displaying both strength and wisdom. He wears a cloak of rich fabric over a finely tailored tunic, with an aura of authority and leadership. The ring on his finger glows subtly, hinting at its magical properties.
